brief.title: Release freeze decision
brief.goal: The team agrees to freeze releases for the week of the launch.
brief.audience: Twelve engineers who dislike freezes because they slow down fixes.
brief.bigIdea: A one-week freeze keeps the launch stable and costs us almost nothing.

points.text: Last launch broke on a late merge
points.example: Two hours of downtime from one Friday deploy

brief.openingLine: Last launch, one Friday merge cost us two hours of downtime.
brief.closingLine: Freeze releases from the 20th to the 27th, and page me for any exception.

issues.problem: The single point proves the freeze reduces risk, but never shows why it costs the team almost nothing.
issues.action: Add a point that shows engineers can still ship urgent fixes through an exception path.

issues.problem: The claim that the freeze costs almost nothing will meet resistance from engineers who believe freezes slow down fixes.
issues.action: Soften the claim or back it with a point about how exceptions keep urgent work moving.
